Who I am

More than
a résumé.

I grew up on the water and in the mountains. The ocean taught me patience, timing, and the nerve to commit when the wave is steep. Those aren't just surfing lessons. They're how I show up at work, in relationships, and in every new challenge I take on.

My career has spanned enterprise revenue, GTM strategy, organizational transformation, and consulting: helping global institutions like the World Economic Forum and United Nations navigate change, to scaling revenue for high-growth technology companies, to advising executive teams on how to build for the long term. I'm drawn to complex problems, human-centred solutions, and work that actually matters.

I believe the best version of any business, and any person, lives at the intersection of discipline and curiosity. I'm still trying to find mine. That search is what this site is about.

"I've never been interested in being the loudest person in the room. I'm interested in asking the question nobody else thought to ask."

What I stand for

Core values.

01
Commit to the drop
Hesitation is the real risk. In sales and in surfing, you read the situation, make your call, and commit. Half-measures don't close deals. They get you wiped out.
02
Radical curiosity
The best discovery sessions feel like conversations, not interrogations. I'm genuinely interested in how organizations work and where they're stuck.
03
Earn the paddle out
Nothing worth having comes easy. I believe in doing the unglamorous work: the research, the prep, the honest debrief after a miss. That earns the right to win.
04
Leave the lineup better
The best surfers share waves. The best salespeople build ecosystems. I measure success not just by my numbers, but by the colleagues and clients I've helped along the way.
